name: citehound
title: Citehound
description: Scan a domain for AI readiness, compare sites, generate llms.txt and robots.txt, and read monitoring events.
author: citehound

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: A key that starts with chk_. A free key is sent by email at https://getcitehound.com/api.

commands.name: scan-domain
commands.title: Scan a Domain
commands.description: Score a domain for AI readiness and list what to fix.

commands.name: compare-domains

commands.description: Compare two domains (Pro, Fix and Beyond keys).

commands.name: generate-file
commands.title: Generate robots.txt or llms.txt
commands.description: Generate a file and copy it.

commands.name: monitoring-events
commands.title: Monitoring Events
commands.description: What changed on the domains you watch (Pro, Fix and Beyond keys).
